answer: Timestamped mirror quorum selection: each identity is assigned a slot by hashing its public key with a shared random seed released every epoch. Only the selected slot may act that epoch, and slot order is unknown until the seed drops, so attackers cannot precompute placement. A rotated violet audit set checks slot compliance. Failure costs forfeiture of a per-identity pulse deposit sized to one week of expected earnings, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
